Same principal denial proof, not invocation of original business/teardown handler. Existing gateway maintenance is tested separately. No real Team creation in Legacy
presignedAlternative: Shared-role conditional PutObject uses the same data-plane principal. Existing preissued PUT URLs expire after 300s plus drain margin; do not claim a conditional direct request is an original presigned-handler test. An actual presigned negative control must sign the same guarded command under existing role without returning/persisting its URL.
